title: Open Values Criterion v0.1
description: One thing the options in a facts file are scored on, such as fossil-fuel financing or fees, with a key, a name and a note on how its scores were made.

key.description: The criterion's id, in lower case with _ between words, such as "environment". Entries use it as the key in their scores and provenance. Reusing a key that other files use joins this criterion to the same value across the site.

label.description: The name shown to people for this criterion in this file, such as "Fossil-fuel financing".

tier.description: How the scores on this criterion were made. "measured" is an open-data fact such as a price or a Nutri-Score, shown exactly. "certified" is a third-party certification such as B Corp. "assessed" is a researched judgement, shown as a band rather than an exact number, and each score should cite its source. Missing is read as "assessed".

source.description: Where the scores on this criterion come from as a whole, either a short label for scores researched by hand or the name of an open database.

description.description: A sentence saying what this criterion measures.
